name: Power Electronics Efficiency
description: Efficiency of the power electronics module. Checks whether sufficient sustained power can be delivered.

elements.name: Power Electronics Efficiency
elements.description: Efficiency under realistic operating conditions. Unknown before integrated testing.

elements.name: Required Sustained Power
elements.description: Minimum sustained power for competitive performance

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(eta) = P_DC_max · eta; F = P_DC_max (≈ 90 kW), f = 0
consistency_relations.upr_description: Sustained output power is an affine function of efficiency: P_sust = P_DC_max · η. This parametric mapping scales the efficiency uncertainty set by the DC input power constant, projecting it into the power domain where it must exceed P_req = 80 kW.
